tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Meta launches Muse Spark Open, a new open-weight artificial intelligence model. Confirmed by The Guardian: Meta claims it rivals top Chinese open-weight models.
A Hawaii mother is suing OpenAI over children's data. Reported by SFist: Eight states have filed separate lawsuits as well.
Anthropic is offering artificial intelligence policy expertise through a Singapore pact. Reported by Singapore Business Review.
DeepSeek has announced an apology and compensation plan. Reported by 中华网: The company is offering a full refund of consumption amounts.
Microsoft has unveiled a 2.8 trillion-parameter artificial intelligence model. Reported by BigGo Finance: Microsoft claims 4–12x efficiency gains over DeepSeek.
Free every hour.
